comment: Advisories the security audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) sets aside, one per GHSA id.
Each waiver names why the fix is out of reach and the date it stops working; past that
date the gate is red again until the waiver is renewed in a reviewed change or the
dependency moves. A waiver for an advisory the audit no longer reports fails the gate,
so these get deleted rather than accumulated. Never waive by package or by severity.

waivers.reason: Patched only in zod 4.6.6 (the advisory's range was extended to every version below it on 2026-10-23). The tree holds zod 3.25.76: @codespar/api-types declares ^3.23.0, and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.1 reaches it through zod-to-json-schema ^3.25.1, which does not take zod 4. Moving api-types to zod 4 is a published-contract change for its consumers and still leaves the nested zod 3 under zod-to-json-schema, so the finding would stay. Exposure: a client validating API responses with bounded schemas; no untrusted oversized collection is parsed on the request path of these packages.
waivers.revisit: When @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ships on zod 4 without zod-to-json-schema, or when @codespar/api-types takes zod 4 in its own PR.
